title: Data Campus - An idle game based on data centers
author: Careless-Flower6059
selftext:
**Build the internet, one rack at a time.**

[https://behuzer.itch.io/data-campus](https://behuzer.itch.io/data-campus)

I'm looking for volunteer playtesters that would be willing to test the game and give me some feedback. It would be great to hear from people and get the logs as well. 

I used Claude Code for the entirety of the game. I basically gave the ideas and the direction on where I want the game to go and the code did the rest. One of the main issues I had was were the visuals (this is the updated version) but originally it was very 'Claude' and could tell immediately that it was vibe-coded, which I don't think is a bad thing but the community seems to not have accepted it yet.

Any recommendations for sites that can help me create original and characteristics visuals would be greatly appreciated! 

**------------------------------------**

Data Campus is an idle builder game where you run a data centre, digging raw materials, turning them into chips, managing the power and cooling for the racks and supplying servers for companies: start-ups, photo apps, backup firms and AI labs. You can join corporations and compete in weekly leaderboards. 

Everything you build is on the map, and you can watch it work.

It's free and plays in your browser on phone or computer. On a phone, add it to your home screen for the full-screen app version.

Your feedback would be very hepful at this stage.

Any comments, as harsh as they could be, would be greatly appreciated to help develop the game. 

I hope you enoy the game and looking forward to any comments!
